# opnsense_bind_dnsbl_settings (Resource)

BIND DNS blocklists and safe-search enforcement (**Services ▸ BIND ▸ Configuration ▸ DNSBL**, plugin `os-bind`). This is a singleton: import it with the ID `bind_dnsbl_settings` before managing it. Attributes left unset keep their current value.

## Example Usage

```terraform
import {
  to = opnsense_bind_dnsbl_settings.this
  id = "bind_dnsbl_settings"
}

resource "opnsense_bind_dnsbl_settings" "this" {
  enabled         = true
  forcesafegoogle = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) This will enable the use of DNS Blocklists for ADs, Malware, or both.
- `forcesafeduckduckgo` (Boolean) This will force SafeSearch.
- `forcesafegoogle` (Boolean) This will force SafeSearch.
- `forcesafeyoutube` (Boolean) This will force safe Youtube browsing.
- `forcestrictbing` (Boolean) This will force safe search when using Bing.
- `type` (Set of String) Select which kind of DNSBL you want to use. One of `aa`, `ag`, `bla`, `blf`, `blp`, `ca`, `el`, `emd`, `ep`, `hpa`, `hpf`, `hpp`, `hup`, `mw`, `nc`, `pt`, `rw`, `sa`, `st`, `sb`, `ws`, `wsu`, `wse`, `yy`.
- `whitelists` (Set of String) List of domains to whitelist. It will add a entry for the domains itself and all sub domains.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `bind_dnsbl_settings`.
